item.tib: gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma byin rlabs dang mkha' 'gro dngos grub kyi gdams pa
item.coloph: 'od ldan 'bar mas lung bstan nas/ khro gnyan rgyal mtshan bdag gis yi ger bkod/ mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gcod rgyad las/ bla ma'i byin rlabs man ngag go 'di la yi dam byas pa na/ gnyan sa ci ltar rtsub na yang / ldog dang khrel ba mi srid do//
